title: Admin Login Bypass
impact: Bypasses authentication allowing unauthorized access to the admin account.
remediation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements for all database inputs.

title: DOM XSS in Search Bar
impact: Executes malicious JavaScript in the victim's browser.
remediation: Implement context-aware output encoding and strict CSP headers.

title: XSS Alert Execution
impact: Executes arbitrary JavaScript when the payload is rendered.
remediation: Ensure all user input is sanitized and HTML encoded before rendering.
